rules.statement: When a court orders the sale of property, the executor no longer has authority to dispose of the property except upon further orders of the Court. The sale by the court takes precedence over subsequent sales by the executor.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that all this can be ignored in considering whether the sale to the defendants prevails over the sale to the plaintiff. In my opinion, when the Court exercised its jurisdiction and took upon itself the sale of the property, the executor had no longer any authority to dispose of the property, except upon further orders of Court, and cannot be allowed to defeat the acts of the Court in regard to the sale."
